patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, indicating issues with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
A significant number of reviews indicate negative experiences with staff attitude or service, such as rudeness or unhelpfulness.
Customers frequently express dissatisfaction with the pricing, finding it too high or not offering good value for money.
Several reviews mention excessive wait times for service or food, leading to frustration.
A notable number of reviews mention general negative experiences not fitting into specific categories.
Some customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or environment to be unappealing or uncomfortable.
A few reviews highlight concerns regarding the cleanliness of the establishment, including tables, restrooms, or general dining areas.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, indicating issues with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of low-quality ingredients, or lack of adherence to recipes.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of reviews indicate negative experiences with staff attitude or service, such as rudeness or unhelpfulness.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training, inadequate staffing levels leading to employee stress, or poor management oversight of customer interactions.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently express dissatisfaction with the pricing, finding it too high or not offering good value for money.
root_causes.cause: Misalignment between perceived value and cost, or pricing strategy that is not competitive with similar establishments.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews mention excessive wait times for service or food, leading to frustration.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing in the kitchen or front-of-house, inefficient order processing, or poor capacity management during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: Some customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or environment to be unappealing or uncomfortable.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or lack of attention to the overall dining environment.

root_causes.pattern: A few reviews highlight concerns regarding the cleanliness of the establishment, including tables, restrooms, or general dining areas.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff dedicated to cleaning, or lack of regular maintenance.
